verdict.rationale: Conductor documents repository-scoped 'General preferences' that apply broad instructions to its agents, which covers the core idea of per-project conventions. The evidence does not show this is a committed project instructions file, nor does it describe how the underlying agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) pick up such files. Missing for 10: evidence of a file-based, version-controlled instructions mechanism; detail on how coding standards are defined and enforced; independent or hands-on corroboration.
